definitions.explanation: Describing a material or substance that is physically hard, firm, and not easily deformed. Used as a technical or descriptive term for material properties.

examples.japanese: {硬質|こうしつ}な⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{硬質|こうしつ}⟦{小麦|こむぎ}→小麦：01407_komugi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This flour is made from hard wheat.

examples.japanese: {硬質|こうしつ}な⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦ケース→ケース：03841_keesu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{衝撃|しょうげき}→衝撃：08678_shougeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: Cases made from hard materials are resistant to impact.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a no-adjective ({硬質|こうしつ}な) or as a prefix in compounds. Common in product descriptions, material science, and food terminology ({硬質|こうしつ}⟦{小麦|こむぎ}→小麦：01407_komugi⟧ for durum wheat).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {硬質|こうしつ}⟦{小麦|こむぎ}→小麦：01407_komugi⟧ (hard/durum wheat)
- {硬質|こうしつ}⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧ (hard rubber)
- {硬質|こうしつ}な⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧ (hard material)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{軟質|なんしつ}→軟質：29370_nanshitsu⟧: soft, flexible — the opposite
- ⟦{硬|かた}い→硬い：01116_katai⟧: hard — the everyday adjective for hardness
